regime.label: Short-gamma Protection build hits a fresh 5-day high as put OI surges 40.9% into a 30.0-point gap below the 1100 flip, 77 DTE
evidence: Cumulative net GEX only turns positive above the 1100-1110 boundary; spot at 1070.0 sits 30.0 points below it, narrowed from 34.1 points on 07-11, even as the flip itself has held that boundary for two straight sessions after drifting up from a 1080-1090 crossing on 07-08/07-10.

Total put OI is up 40.9% over 5 sessions (11,629 to 16,386), with the 910 tail-put strike alone +78.8% (3,210 to 5,741) and +23.6% (+1,097 contracts) since 07-11 - the largest single-strike build of the window, though only 58 lots of same-day volume were recorded (a Vol2Vol caution given the unscraped 07-13 session, so part of the build likely accrued over more than one day).

P/C OI ratio hit a fresh 5-day high of 1.4556 (from 1.4177 on 07-11) while 25-delta IV skew widened to a fresh high of 3.26 vol points (put IV 16.45% at the 1000 strike vs call IV 13.19% at 1120) - genuine put-richness building alongside a rallying tape, not a fear spike.
The 1080 call wall has been the single largest call strike for all 5 sessions (1,834 to 1,906 OI, +3.9%), capping price 0.9% above spot and locally dampening the broader short-gamma read.

S50U26.today_summary: S50U26 closed 1070.0 on 07-14, +4.1 points (+0.38%) versus the last available session (07-11), extending its recovery from the 1040.4 low set 07-09 to +29.6 points (+2.85%). The P/C OI ratio hit a fresh 5-day high of 1.4556 (from 1.4177) and 25-delta IV skew widened to a fresh high of 3.26 vol points (from 2.63), both confirming genuine put-side hedging demand even as price grinds higher. ATM IV eased to 14.40% (a 9.7-point, 0.9% one-sigma daily move), mid the week's 13.79-15.03% range, while the persistent 1080 call wall (1,906 OI, +3.9% over 5 sessions) keeps capping the tape 10 points above spot.
what_changed: Future +4.1 points (+0.38%) to 1070.0 since 07-11's close, +29.6 points (+2.85%) off the 1040.4 low of 07-09.

Put OI at the 910 strike +1,097 contracts (+23.6%) to 5,741 - the largest single-strike build of the window, though confirmed same-day volume was only 58 lots (a Vol2Vol caution given the unscraped 07-13 gap).
P/C OI ratio rose to a fresh 5-day high of 1.4556 (from 1.4177); 25-delta IV skew widened to a fresh high of 3.26 vol pts (from 2.63).

Max pain held at 1050 for a second straight session (up from 1040 across 07-08 to 07-10); the gamma flip stayed at the 1100-1110 boundary, narrowing the short-gamma gap to spot to 30.0 points from 34.1.
S50U26.five_day_thesis: Max pain stepped up from 1040 (07-08 to 07-10) to 1050 (07-11 onward) even as futures swung from 1057.7 (07-08) down to a 1040.4 low (07-09) and back up 2.85% to 1070.0 today - a round trip that shows the anchor drifting with realized flow rather than sitting purely structural. The cumulative gamma flip migrated over the window - crossing zero between 1080-1090 on 07-08 and 07-10, widening to 1090-1100 at the 07-09 selloff low, then settling at the 1100-1110 boundary for the last two sessions (07-11, 07-14) - narrowing the short-gamma gap from spot to 30.0 points today versus 34.1 on 07-11 and roughly 50 points at the 07-09 trough. Total put OI is up 40.9% over the 5 sessions (11,629 to 16,386), with the 910 tail strike alone up 78.8% (3,210 to 5,741), while call OI grew a slower 15.3% (9,764 to 11,257) - the book is building protection faster than upside conviction. The 1080 call wall has been the single most stable level all week (call OI 1,834 to 1,906, always the largest strike, always sitting 0.9-2% above spot), capping every session's close below it even as the broader short-gamma zone compresses toward it. 25-delta IV skew expanded from 1.78 (07-08) to a fresh 3.26 high today, while ATM IV round-tripped from 13.79% up to a 15.03% selloff-day spike and back down to 14.40%, so the current put-richness reads as steady hedging flow rather than a fear spike.

strategies.name: Put debit spread 1050P / 1000P
strategies.rationale: Put OI is up 40.9% over 5 sessions (11,629 to 16,386) with 77 DTE still on the clock - a Protection-zone insurance build, not a pin - and the book stays net short gamma 30.0 points under the 1100-1110 flip, so a debit spread rides that same hedging flow at defined, capped cost.
strategies.defined_risk: Max loss = net debit paid (last-price debit approx 9.9 pts x 200 baht/pt = approx 1,980 baht per spread); no further margin exposure.
strategies.invalidation: A daily close back above the 1080 call wall without a matching put-OI build would signal the protection thesis fading rather than the rally stalling.

strategies.name: Call debit spread 1080C / 1110C
strategies.rationale: The 1080 call wall (1,906 OI, +3.9% over 5 sessions, the largest call strike every session) is the nearest live resistance just 0.9% above spot; a confirmed break on rising volume would push spot through the 1100-1110 flip zone where dealers turn long gamma, so a debit spread captures that momentum at defined risk rather than fading it.
strategies.defined_risk: Max loss = net debit paid (last-price debit approx 13.0 pts x 200 baht/pt = approx 2,600 baht per spread); no further margin exposure.
strategies.invalidation: A daily close back below 1050 (today's max pain and near-put wall) invalidates the breakout attempt and favors a fade back toward the pain anchor.

S50U26.prediction: Bias is neutral with a mild bullish tilt while spot (1070.0) closes the gap to the 1100-1110 gamma flip (30.0 points, narrowed from 34.1 on 07-11) and holds above the 1050 max-pain/near-put-wall level; the persistent 1080 call wall (1,906 OI, largest call strike for 5 straight sessions) has capped the tape 0.9% above spot throughout the window. A daily close above 1080 on rising call volume would test the 1100-1110 flip/25-delta-call band directly and could flip the book toward net long gamma; a reversal back below 1050 would risk reopening the wider short-gamma range seen at the 1040.4 low on 07-09. At 77 DTE, treat directional conviction as low.
S50U26.risk_note: Educational analysis only - not trade advice, and nothing here should be read as a signal to execute a position. SET50 index options are cash-settled on the index with no physical delivery, so any pull toward max pain (1050) or the 1100-1110 gamma flip is a tendency, not a guarantee, and pinning mechanics here are structurally weaker than for physically-settled single stocks. This series is 77 days from expiry with OI still building fast (put OI +40.9% over 5 sessions), so directional conviction should stay low, and defined-risk structures still carry their full stated max loss.
